stem:
A group of students was conducting an investigation with plants. One group of plants was placed inside a closet. The other group of plants was placed next to a window. After two weeks, the plants next to the window were taller and healthier than the plants in the closet.

Which statement BEST explains the difference in plant growth?

options.label: A
options.text: The plants next to the window were able to convert more light energy into chemical energy.

options.label: B
options.text: The plants next to the window were able to convert more thermal energy into light energy.

options.label: C
options.text: The plants next to the window were able to convert more thermal energy into mechanical energy.

options.label: D
options.text: The plants next to the window were able to convert more light energy into electrical energy.

visual_elements: The image shows a multiple-choice question with four options labeled A, B, C, and D.
